messages.text: BL-1700 🎵 in progress — The model steward's probe runs the real local parcel driver against a real aider seat on a named model in a throwaway repository per run, over five committed coder fixture tickets whose acceptance starts red, with a turn cap and a wall-clock cap, a scorecard per run and a summary that applies the four-of-five coder bar - on demand, never in the standing suite, never touching the live repository or router
